name: Text Embedding
description: Generate embedding vectors from text, documents, or chunks using an embedded provider selection.

outputs.name: vectors
outputs.description: Dense embedding vectors with source metadata for semantic similarity.

controllers.name: embedding
controllers.description: Embedding handle containing provider/model metadata and generated vectors for controller-driven vector storage or retrieval.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Embedding provider. Ollama with nomic-embed-text is the local default; OpenAI and Gemini embedding models are available when configured.

parameters.name: model_name
parameters.description: Embedding model available for the selected provider.

parameters.name: tokenizer_name
parameters.description: Optional Hugging Face tokenizer repository. Leave blank to use the embedding model repository tokenizer.
